resources.string: A quiet home screen: your apps in one alphabetical list, a few favourites, and a theme you can make your own.
No internet, no account. Strata keeps everything on this phone.
Favourites sit on your home screen. Choose up to %1$d, or skip and add them later.
The Home button will then open Strata.
You can switch back at any time: Settings › Apps › Default apps › Home app.
Nothing else to do here. The Home button already opens Strata.
Long-press empty space on home for themes and settings. Swipe up to search.
That couldn\'t be saved. Try again.
Strata isn\'t your home app yet
You can try again, choose Strata in the system settings, or keep using Strata as a normal app for now.
Your phone didn\'t switch the home app
Some phones change the home app only from their own settings.
Open Settings, search for \"Home app\" or \"Default apps\", choose Strata, then come back.
On this phone (HyperOS 2 or later) the system may not allow another home app at all, or only with three-button navigation. Strata stays usable as a normal app.
